note: mcp.svatantrya.net — THE public bundle: every public read, one plugin install. 35 tools, no auth.
instructions: Svatantrya: Sanskrit library, study and formal layer. Read-only: never invent Sanskrit; machine-proposed is labelled, never shipped as established; unanswered is stated. FOUR-TURN WORKFLOW (use this order): 1) WORK STATUS: openpatala__resolve {q:<title-or-id>} then openpatala__get_bibliography_dossier; report work_id, edition_count, witness_count (0 means UNPINNED), rights, and status. 2) CONCEPT: for 'what is a <Sanskrit term>' call formal__evidence {theorem:<term or theorem>} plus scholar__search_texts {query:<term>}; state the tier (T/R) and the scope note ('finite table only; not doctrine'), and never present a theorem as a translation. 3) OCCURRENCES: use scholar__search_texts results as passages; every locator must come from a tool, never invented; report layer/gate state per passage. 4) RELATED: treeka__chain {work} for argued nodes/cruxes/formal refs/essays; scholar__ref_links {id} for the id graph. Empty essays/formal refs come back with an essays_note/formal_note saying it is a gap, not a denial — repeat that, do not drop it. Tool names are <server>__<tool>. Layers in plain words: draft-translation, literal-gloss (meaning-forks live here), argument-map, reading-translation, essence, register-render, final-translation, song; machine keys T1/L0/ARGMAP/L2/C1/C2/L3/L4 also work. Counts carry denominators or they do not ship.
